name: genpark-agentic-flight-delay-eu261-compensation-claimant-skill
description: Automated Flight Delay & Cancellation EU261 / UK261 Regulatory Compensation Claimant. Computes flight route Great-Circle distances via Haversine geometry, applies statutory compensation tiers (up to EUR 600), screens extraordinary circumstance defenses, and drafts legally binding claim demand notices for airline passenger relations.
